description: A basic agent-based simulation designed for testing setup and execution processes. It involves generic entities with simple behaviors in a grid environment.

behaviors.name: move
behaviors.description: Agents move to a random adjacent grid cell.
behaviors.algorithm: At each time step, an agent moves to a random adjacent cell with a probability defined by move_probability.

behaviors.name: interact
behaviors.algorithm: Agents within the interaction_radius of each other have a chance to change their state.

interactions.name: proximity_interaction
interactions.description: Agents change their state when in proximity to another agent.
interactions.effect: Agents change their state based on predefined rules.

algorithms.state_change: Change state based on rules and proximity.

files.name: agents.py
files.description: Defines the Agent class and its behaviors.

files.name: environment.py
files.description: Defines the environment setup and management.

files.name: simulation.py
files.description: Manages the simulation execution and time steps.
